chunks: From him, raising it, he said:
Whoever spends the night in a house and a room alone, let him recite Ayat Al-Kursi and let him say: 'O Allah, comfort my loneliness, secure my awe, and assist me upon my loneliness.'

key_terms.آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ: Ayat Al-Kursi (The Verse of the Throne, Quran 2:255)

ai.seo_question: What should one recite and say for protection when sleeping alone at night?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from Al-Kafi underscores the spiritual significance of solitude (wahdah) as a state requiring divine accompaniment, linking the recitation of Ayat al-Kursi with a specific dua for comfort and security. Scholars highlight that seeking refuge in this manner transforms the vulnerability of being alone into an opportunity for intimate communion with Allah, reinforcing the concept of divine presence (hudhur) even in physical isolation. This practice is often cited in devotional manuals as a means to ward off the 'fear of the unknown' and spiritual anxiety during night prayers or sleep.
